text: [issue by CynSolveroftheAbsolute] **Describe the bug** Heyo, if you see this somewhere else, I'm bulk copy-pasting 'cuz I've got ~460 warnings in Kubejs and none of them are mine :D Not sure what the exact steps to reproduce are, but I do know your mod has an incorrect recipe or two. I'm attaching the KubeJS server script log so you can see what recipes are causing issues and try to understand why, but if they're like the first one that I made an issue for, which I knew a bit more about, you've left a residue of porting from 1.20 to 1.21 in a recipe (`"item": {"id": "minecraft:cobblestone"}` when it should be `"id": "minecraft:cobblestone"` in the output) and Kube's unhappy about it, which makes me unhappy because it takes so much longer to load with ~460 warnings than without. Search `'[YOUR MOD ID]:` in the log and it'll pull up all the recipes from your mod that are giving me trouble, and probably will give someone else trouble down the line. If this ISN'T the issue/fix I think it is, let me know and I'll look into it more and get back to you **To Reproduce** Annoyingly, don't know **Additional context** - Mod version: 1.5.10 - (Neo)Forge version: 21.1.219 - Create version: 6.0.9 Log file: https://mclo.gs/9E9uqAD [comment by Staegrin (none)] same versions Mod version: 1.5.10 (Neo)Forge version: 21.1.219 Create version: 6.0.9 I think the cake recipe was broken as well. was: `{ "type": "create:filling", "ingredients": [ { "item": "createaddition:cake_base_baked" }, { "type": "fluid_tag", "amount": 1000, "fluid_tag": "c:milk" } ], "results": [ { "id": "minecraft:cake" } ] }` Changing it to: `{ "type": "create:filling", "ingredients": [ { "item": "createaddition:cake_base_baked" }, { "type": "fluid_stack", "amount": 1000, "fluid": "minecraft:milk" } ], "results": [ { "id": "minecraft:cake" } ] }` using c:milk doesn't seem to work. Create's own recipe of filling a bucket with milk uses minecraft:milk while the compat recipe for the milk bottle from farmer's delight and the built in sweet roll recipe are also broken and can be fixed by using minecraft:milk as fluid_stack instead of fluid_tag c:milk [comment by Staegrin (none)] Sorry the c:milk tag was being broken by Engineers Delight. Even when adding the tag back with KubeJS it still would not work. [comment by mrh0 (owner)] Fixed in 1.5.11
